name: Healthcare
tagline: Automate clinical ops, claims, and care coordination without sacrificing safety.
overview: Health systems drown in documentation, prior auth, and fragmented EHR workflows. Agentic AI can cut administrative load while keeping clinicians in the loop for high-stakes decisions.
painPoints: Prior authorization backlogs delaying care by days
Clinicians spending 2+ hours daily on documentation
Claims denials from incomplete coding and missing clinical evidence
strategicImpact: 1–2 hours reclaimed per clinician per day

singleAgents.name: Prior Auth Navigator
singleAgents.role: Assembles clinical evidence and submits prior authorizations
singleAgents.trigger: Order placed that requires payer approval

singleAgents.name: Ambient Chart Scribe
singleAgents.role: Drafts structured clinical notes from encounter audio
singleAgents.trigger: Visit ends or clinician requests note draft
singleAgents.output: SOAP/APSO draft ready for clinician sign-off

singleAgents.name: Denial Recovery Agent
singleAgents.role: Diagnoses claim denials and drafts appeals with evidence

singleAgents.name: Care Gap Outreach Agent
singleAgents.role: Identifies overdue preventive care and schedules outreach

multiAgent.name: Care Coordination Swarm
multiAgent.description: End-to-end post-discharge coordination that reduces readmissions while keeping nurses as supervisors.

supervisor.name: Care Orchestrator
supervisor.responsibilities: Owns the patient episode, sequences tasks, escalates clinical risk, and maintains a single source of truth.
supervisor.routingLogic: Routes by acuity and task type: clinical questions → Clinical Triage, logistics → Logistics Agent, benefits → Benefits Agent, documentation → Chart Agent.

subAgents.name: Clinical Triage Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Risk score + recommended pathway to Orchestrator

subAgents.name: Logistics Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Confirmed appointments and open logistics gaps

subAgents.name: Benefits Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Coverage constraints that reshape the care plan

subAgents.name: Chart Synthesis Agent
subAgents.contextHandoff: Signed summary package for EHR and patient portal

multiAgent.conflictResolution: Clinical disagreements escalate to on-call nurse within SLA; conflicting schedules re-plan with patient preference weights; any PHI tool failure pauses the run and pages ops.

workflow.label: Input
workflow.description: Ingest discharge event, vitals, meds, and payer constraints from EHR + ADT feed.

workflow.label: Reason
workflow.description: Orchestrator plans a 7-day care pathway and selects specialist agents by risk tier.

workflow.label: Tool Execution
workflow.description: Agents call scheduling, benefits, messaging, and chart tools in parallel where safe.

workflow.label: Human-in-the-Loop
workflow.description: Nurse reviews escalations, high-risk plans, and any outbound clinical advice before send.

workflow.label: Output
workflow.description: Patient receives plan; EHR care plan updates; analytics dashboards track adherence.
